answer: A concrete defense is adaptive-difficulty onboarding: every new identity must dock at a registration jetty and solve a hash puzzle before it can earn. A raven-like watchdog tracks the arrival rate and ratchets required leading zeros upward whenever registrations surge. A falcon-fast fleet of clones hits a moving target: the farmer burns one escalating puzzle per puppet with no bulk discount, while an honest newcomer solves it once. Solved proofs live on-ledger, so verifiers reject reuse at every payout, making bulk identity farming cost more than it can ever return.
